name: Tachibana Yakumo
source:
She is a girl with black hair from the remote, far east. When Yugudora Kingdom expanded further east, a state of war developed in the region, and she, whose hometown had been destroyed, came to the royal capital for a certain reason.
Her skill of sword reaches a genius level, which can be demonstrated completely even in the "Clarias".
Mysterious as she is, she often feels hungry and patronizes the cafe where Shelly works.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
